raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Adds `mm_payload: "metadata"` to render requests: `kwargs_data` is null and `mm_metadata` stays. Prefill can then load embeddings through the EC connector without render serializing the processed tensors. Closes #64997, part of #46722.

## Claims

- A `metadata` render returns the same token IDs, hashes, placeholders and `mm_metadata` as a `tensors` render, without the tensors.
- Prefill from a `metadata` render matches single-instance output end to end.
- `none` and the `tensors` default are unchanged, except for the fix below.
- Fixes a 400 on `tensors` when one modality in a request has no metadata, such as image + video on LLaVA-OneVision and Gemma 4.

## Validation

```bash
pytest tests/entrypoints/scale_out/token_in_token_out/test_mm_serde.py  # 29 passed
pytest tests/entrypoints/scale_out/render/test_render.py                # 50 passed
MODEL=<model> bash tests/entrypoints/scale_out/ec_integration/run_scale_out_ec_e2e_test.sh
```

Before the fix: 11 of the new or changed test cases fail. `RenderedGenerateRequest` does not exist on main, so alias it to let the file collect:

```bash
git checkout origin/main -- vllm
T=tests/entrypoints/scale_out/token_in_token_out/test_mm_serde.py
sed -i '/^    RenderedGenerateRequest,$/d' $T
echo 'RenderedGenerateRequest = GenerateRequest' >> $T
pytest $T tests/entrypoints/scale_out/render/test_render.py -k 'metadata or mm_kwargs_is_alias'
```

```text
Input should be 'tensors' or 'none' [type=literal_error, input_value='metadata', ...]
Value error, mm_metadata must use the same modalities as mm_hashes
assert {200, 400} == {<HTTPStatus.OK: 200>}
11 failed, 14 passed
```

I extended the EC e2e test so prefill features come from a `metadata` render, after asserting they match the `tensors` render. Single image, two images and text all match the baseline:

| Model | GPU | Metadata source |
|---|---|---|
| Qwen3-VL-2B | 2 L4 | declared `embedding_fields` |
| LLaVA-OneVision | 1 A100 (both instances), `MAX_MODEL_LEN=16384` | `keep_on_cpu` only |

Response bytes from `vllm launch render` on CPU:

| Model, request | `tensors` | `metadata` | `none` | `mm_metadata` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Qwen2-VL-2B, image | 1,878,981 | 3,411 | 3,285 | present |
| Qwen2-VL-2B, image + video | 3,122,734 | 5,055 | 4,800 | present |
| LLaVA-OneVision, image | 3,554,748 | 15,598 | 15,488 | present |
| LLaVA-OneVision, image + video | 22,451,203 (400 on main) | 37,564 | 37,564 | null |
| Gemma-4-31B, video | 20,869,285 | 9,679 | 9,205 | present |
| Gemma-4-31B, image + video | 26,085,713 (400 on main) | 11,182 | 11,182 | null |

The GPU runs used `8530a778f7`, and one helper was inlined after them. The non-test files this PR touches are otherwise unchanged through `b8c04dd3b4`; the current base, `76c6f3f2a9`, changes only `responses/protocol.py` among them.

## Details

- **New value, not a changed `none`.** #62152 and #64685 rely on `none` being layout only.
- **`RenderedGenerateRequest`.** Render returns `GenerateRequest`, whose EC check rejects metadata-only items, and render output has no EC params until encode runs. Without this subclass every `metadata` render with metadata returns 400, and keeping metadata under `none` would too. `/inference/v1/generate` still validates its input as `GenerateRequest`, so metadata-only items without `ec_transfer_params` are still rejected.
- **Null when incomplete.** The encoder used to drop a modality without metadata, and `MultiModalFeatures` then rejected the mismatch. `mm_metadata` is now null if any modality has none, which keeps it complete when present (see #56069). Callers see null and fall back to sending the media, as `renderer.md` now says.
- **Limits.** Prefill was not run on Gemma 4 or on real audio. Image + audio is covered by unit tests only. In the EC e2e test, encode takes `kwargs_data` from a `tensors` render. I did not run encode from `content_parts` on a GPU. On CPU, that path gives the same hashes as render (Qwen2-VL-2B and LLaVA-OneVision, 3 requests each), but it expands rendered `token_ids` again (87 to 150 tokens for one image on Qwen2-VL-2B). That is existing behavior and this PR doesn't change it. A `metadata` response with null `mm_metadata` must not go to generate, same as `none`; #62152 turns that into a 400. I did not measure serving latency: #64997 reports the prefill cost of the current fallback.
- **Overlaps.** #60526 moves `MMPayload`, so whichever lands second needs a small rebase. #64685 will need the same value in its Rust render.

---

@@ -166,17 +166,105 @@ should split those fields:
 - Legacy clients that ignore `mm_metadata` and keep sending `kwargs_data`
   continue to work.
 
-Callers that need only the token layout and item hashes, such as cache-aware
-routers, can set `"mm_payload": "none"` on the render request. The response
-then keeps `mm_hashes` and `mm_placeholders` and sets `kwargs_data` and
-`mm_metadata` to null, so the processed tensors are neither serialized nor sent.
-Do not forward such a response to `/inference/v1/generate`, which reads a null
-`kwargs_data` as every item being cached. The default, `"tensors"`, returns
-both fields.
+### `mm_payload` modes
+
+`mm_payload` on the render request sets which fields the response carries:
+
+| `mm_payload` | `mm_hashes`, `mm_placeholders` | `mm_metadata` | `kwargs_data` | Use it when |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `"tensors"` (default) | Yes | When available | Yes | The processed tensors should go to a worker. |
+| `"metadata"` | Yes | When available | Null | The encode worker gets the media another way, and prefill loads embeddings through the EC connector. |
+| `"none"` | Yes | Null | Null | Only the token layout and item hashes are needed, such as in a cache-aware router. |
 
 `"return_mm_kwargs": false` is a deprecated alias for `"mm_payload": "none"`
 and is ignored when `mm_payload` is set.
 
+In the diagrams, `features` also carries `mm_hashes` and `mm_placeholders`.
+
+#### `"tensors"`
+
+Render serializes the processed tensors, and the client forwards them to the
+encode worker:
+
+```mermaid
+sequenceDiagram
+    autonumber
+    participant Client
+    participant R as Render
+    participant E as Encode worker
+    participant P as Prefill worker
+
+    Client->>R: POST /v1/chat/completions/render
+    note over R: process media, serialize tensors
+    R-->>Client: token_ids, features (kwargs_data, mm_metadata)
+    Client->>E: POST /inference/v1/generate (kwargs_data)
+    note over E: run encoder
+    E-->>Client: ec_transfer_params
+    Client->>P: POST /inference/v1/generate (mm_metadata, ec_transfer_params)
+    P-->E: EC connector read (P pulls embeddings from E)
+    note over P: prefill
+    P-->>Client: generated output
+```
+
+A single worker can instead take the full response at
+`/inference/v1/generate`.
+
+#### `"metadata"`
+
+Render does not serialize the tensors, so the encode worker needs the media from
+the client:
+
+```mermaid
+sequenceDiagram
+    autonumber
+    participant Client
+    participant R as Render
+    participant E as Encode worker
+    participant P as Prefill worker
+
+    Client->>R: POST /v1/chat/completions/render
+    note over R: process media
+    R-->>Client: token_ids, features (mm_metadata)
+    Client->>E: Request with media
+    note over E: process media, run encoder
+    E-->>Client: ec_transfer_params
+    Client->>P: POST /inference/v1/generate (mm_metadata, ec_transfer_params)
+    P-->E: EC connector read (P pulls embeddings from E)
+    note over P: prefill
+    P-->>Client: generated output
+```
+
+`/inference/v1/generate` rejects this response without `ec_transfer_params`.
+
+#### `"none"`
+
+The response is for routing only:
+
+```mermaid
+sequenceDiagram
+    autonumber
+    participant Client
+    participant R as Render
+    participant W as Worker
+
+    Client->>R: POST /v1/chat/completions/render
+    note over R: process media
+    R-->>Client: token_ids, features (no kwargs_data or mm_metadata)
+    note over Client: choose a worker
+    Client->>W: Original request with media
+    W-->>Client: generated output
+```
+
+Do not forward this response to `/inference/v1/generate`, which reads a null
+`kwargs_data` as every item being cached.
+
+#### Null `mm_metadata`
+
+`mm_metadata` is null if any modality in the request has no metadata fields,
+for example an image and a video on a model that declares them only for video.
+Do not use the prefill form for such a request. With `"metadata"`, both
+fields are then null, so send the media or render with `"tensors"` instead.
+

 The example below shows how a disaggregated encode / prefill coordinator can

+def _render_metadata_features(args, request: dict, rendered: dict) -> dict:
+    """Render without tensors and check it matches the full render."""
+    metadata_rendered = post_json(
+        f"{args.render_url}/v1/chat/completions/render",
+        request | {"mm_payload": "metadata"},

+    assert metadata_rendered["token_ids"] == rendered["token_ids"]
+    metadata_features = metadata_rendered["features"]

+        assert value == rendered["features"][key], key
+    return prefill_features
